blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel-space generation, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 with JiT-L. Applied to ImageNet and the text-to-image dataset GPIC, we show tokenizer encoder scaling laws for diffusability, where extrapolating our approach achieves representations in 7x fewer FLOPs than DINOv2 on ImageNet and 8x fewer FLOPs than WebSSL on GPIC.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一种自我监督的代表性学习方法,用来作为基因模型的象征。 我们的目标通过将数据的点性相互信息纳入系数来监督一种表示损失,我们通过从一个学到的基因模型中提取有条件预测之间的信息差异来估计这些数据。 我们从理论和经验角度证明我们的算法是正确的,表明在DINO和LeJEPA等常用方法失败的情况下,我们对代表性学习的基因方法避免了维度崩溃和特征抑制。 此外,我们显示,我们的代表学习技术是可扩展的;花费更多的计算方法可以预测到更好的潜在标志化。 我们首次对标致剂和基因模型的综合浮动效率进行了认真分析,并表明我们的方法是比直接扩散像素空间生成的计算-优化改进,获得了FID-50K的2.18,与JiT-L. 应用到ImageNet和文本到图像数据集GPIC,我们展示了标致剂编码器缩放法用于易散性,在图像网的FLOP比DINOv2少7x,FLOP比GPIC的WebSSL少8x.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Representation learning decides what information matters. Traditionally, that decision has been guided by downstream tasks: augmentation invariance, for example, encourages representations that preserve semantic content while discarding other latent variables.
Yet representations designed this way have become a foundation for generative modeling, serving as latent tokenizers for diffusion models. Methods such as RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , for example, inherit encoders like DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , whose objectives were not designed to make generation easier. Moreover, these encoders can require orders of magnitude more data and compute to train than the generative models built on top of them. This leaves two basic questions unresolved: what makes a representation good for generation, and is learning one actually more compute-efficient than modeling pixels directly?
blocks.zh:
代表性学习决定信息的重要性。 传统上,这一决定是以下游任务为指导的:例如,增加偏移鼓励保留语义内容的表述,同时抛弃其他潜在变量。
然而,这种表述方式已成为遗传模型的基础,成为扩散模型的潜在表达器。 例如RAE(郑等人,2026年)等方法继承了DINOv2(Oquab等人,2024年)等编码器,其目标并非为了让生成更容易. 此外,这些编码器可以要求数量级的数据和计算来训练,比上面所建的基因模型还要多. 这就留下了两个基本问题没有解决: 是什么使得一个代表对一代人有好处, 并且学习一个实际比模型像素直接更有效?

blocks.en: In this paper, we seek to discover whether there is a representation learning algorithm that demonstrates tokenizer encoder scaling laws: As more compute and data is given to train the tokenizer, generative models trained on these representations converge faster, and the compute optimal balance between training a tokenizer and generative model places nonzero weight on tokenization. Although prior work has shown scaling laws for tokenization ( Yao et al., 2025a ; Hansen-Estruch et al., 2026 ) , these works couple tokenizer decoders, which are a part of the generative process that has been widely shown to improve with scale ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) , with tokenizer encoders that instead have been shown to worsen with scale ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ; Hansen-Estruch et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2025b ) , a phenomenon we discuss in depth.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们试图发现是否有一种表现式学习算法来显示标致编码器缩放定律: 由于提供了更多的计算和数据来训练示标器,因此在这些表示方式上接受过训练的基因模型会更快地汇合起来,在训练示标器和基因模型之间的计算最佳平衡会给示标物化带来非零的重量. 虽然以前的工作显示,标定法(Yao等人,2025年a;Hansen-Estruch等人,2026年),但这些作品是夫妇标定法解码器的一部分,这些标定法是经过广泛证明随着标定法(Kaplan等人,2020年)不断改进的基因过程的一部分,而标定法解码器则因标定法而恶化(Siméoni等人,2025年;Hansen-Estruch等人,2026年;Yao等人,2025年b),这是我们深入讨论的现象。

blocks.en: Toward the goal of discovering scalable encoders, we identify three primary reasons for the failures of current recipes. 1) Feature suppression: Standard representation learning techniques such as Contrastive Learning ( Hadsell et al., 2006 ; van den Oord et al., 2018a ) and LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) can have their objectives saturated by a small number of bits, behavior commonly referred to as feature suppression ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021a ) . Although suppressed objectives may be ideal for tasks like ImageNet probing, where only a few semantic bits need highlighting, in generative modeling all latent variables in the data are sampled. 2) Causal Theoretical Grounding: Representation learning algorithms like contrastive learning optimize a CLS token, but the tokenizer used by methods like RAE is instead “emergent” internal patch features that have demonstrated instability under scaling ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) . 3) Architectural scalability: Classic tokenizers such as VAEs ( Kingma and Welling, 2022 ) and VQ-VAE ( van den Oord et al., 2018b ) bottleneck gradient descent through techniques like the reparameterization trick or straight-through gradient estimation and fail to learn semantics ( Yao et al., 2025b ) , resulting in the transition toward tokenizers based on representation learning such as DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了实现发现可扩展编码器的目标,我们找出了目前配方失败的三个主要原因. 1) 特性抑制:标准表达学习技术,如对比性学习(Hadsell等人,2006年;van den Oord等人,2018年a)和LeJEPA(Balestriero和LeCun,2025年),其目标可被少量比特饱和,行为通常称为特性抑制(Geirhos等人,2020年;Chen等人,2021年a). 虽然被压制的目标对于像ImageNet检测这样的任务来说可能是理想的,在检测数据中所有潜在变量的基因模型中,只有几个语义位需要突出. (2) 因果关系理论 定位:像对比性学习那样的表示式学习算法优化了一个CLS符号,但RAE等方法使用的表示器反而是显示在缩放下不稳定的“紧急”内部补丁特性(Darcet等人,2024年)。 3)建筑可伸缩性:经典的标注剂如VAEs(Kingma and Welling, 2022)和VQ-VAE(van den Oord等人, 2018年b),通过重新校正术或直通梯度估计等技术,瓶颈梯度下降,未能学习语义(姚等人, 2025年b),导致基于DINov2(Oquab等人, 2024年b)等代表学向标注剂过渡.

blocks.en:
To address these issues preventing scalable representations, we propose an approach to move representation learning away from discriminative tasks, such as contrastive learning, and toward generative approaches instead.
Specifically, we observe that Word Embeddings and Contrastive Learning implicitly factorize a pointwise mutual information (PMI) matrix of the data distribution ( Levy and Goldberg, 2014 ; van den Oord et al., 2018a ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . We propose to use a generative model to directly estimate a weighted PMI that our representation learner factorizes explicitly. By factorizing the PMI of the data, we directly inherit the long-studied theoretical properties of Contrastive Learning in our latent space.
By using a generative objective instead of a discriminative objective, our approach both uses no negative samples and is robust to feature suppression, enabling our approach to directly supervise tokenizer patch feature representations rather than relying on intermediate features in a network ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) or excessively destroying information when directly using contrastive representations ( Ramesh, 2022 ) .
Our PMI estimation inherits scalability from existing generative models, we use continuous gradient descent and standard Transformer architectures, and our representation supervision loss is directly interpretable as Nats Squared.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这些问题,防止可扩展的表述,我们建议采取一种办法,使代表学习脱离歧视性任务,例如对比性学习,转而采用基因方法。
具体地说,我们注意到,Word Embeddings and Contrastitual Learning隐含地将数据分布的点性相互信息矩阵(PMI)作为因素(Levy and Goldberg,2014年;van den Oord等人,2018年a); 陈等,2023). 我们建议使用基因模型来直接估计一个加权的PMI,我们的代表学者明确地将这种指数纳入其中。 通过将数据的PMI因素化,我们直接继承了我们潜伏空间中长期研究的矛盾学习理论属性.
通过使用基因目标而不是歧视目标,我们的方法既不使用负面样本,又能强有力地显示抑制特征,使我们能够直接监督象征性补丁的特征表述,而不是依赖网络中的中间特征(郑等人,2026年),或者在直接使用对比表述时过度销毁信息(Ramesh, 2022年)。
我们的PMI估计继承了现有基因模型的可伸缩性,我们使用连续梯度下降和标准变形器架构,我们的代表监督损失可以直接解释为Nats Squared.

blocks.en:
We empirically demonstrate our approach for the task of image generation on both ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) and GPIC ( Chandrasegaran et al., 2026 ) , a text-to-image dataset.
We isolate our gains solely to the diffusability of the encoder by training generative models with Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) , demonstrating scaling directly on pixel generation while using no decoder, perceptual losses, adversarial losses, or external models. We further show that our approach is generalizable to different settings, such as unconditional generation, guided and unguided generation, and GAN+LPIPS decoding ( Goodfellow et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Our resulting approach provides a FLOP-wise performance improvement over JiT, obtaining an FID-50K of 2.18 2.18 with JiT-L.
blocks.zh:
我们在ImageNet(Deng等人,2009年)和GPIC(Chandrasegaran等人,2026年)上以经验证明我们对图像生成任务的态度,这是一个文本到图像数据集。
我们通过培训Latent Forcing(Baade等人,2026年)的基因模型,将我们的收益完全孤立于编码器的易变性,在不使用解码器、知觉损失、对抗性损失或外部模型的同时,直接演示了像素的生成。 我们进一步显示,我们的方法可以概括到不同的场合,如无条件生成,引导和无引导生成,以及GAN+LPIPS解码(Goodfellow等人,2021年;张等人,2018年). 我们由此产生的方法比JiT改进了FLOP的性能,与JiT-L一起获得2.18 2.18的FID-50K.

blocks.en: In summary, we make the following contributions: 1. We introduce Relative Prediction Representations (RePR), a theoretically grounded representation learning algorithm for discovering latent variables within a signal that correlate between different masked views of the data. 2. We provide a practical implementation on real high-dimensional image data. 3. A careful analysis of tokenizer encoder scaling laws and the combined FLOP efficiency of representation learning and generative modeling, improving JiT-L FID-50K on ImageNet to 2.18 2.18 with equal FLOPs and extrapolating to equivalent tokenizer quality 7 × 7\times faster than DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) on ImageNet and 8 × 8\times WebSSL ( Fan et al., 2025 ) on GPIC.

2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Representation Learning. Contrastive Learners ( Chen et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2020 ) are a staple of representation learning that supervise a loss objective by encouraging high similarity between augmented views of the same scene and low similarity across different scenes. Empirically improving on contrastive-style objectives has seen great success in the widely-used DINO v1,v2,v3 series of models ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ) . A longstanding flaw of contrastive objectives is that they struggle with strongly conditioned views, where hard negative examples ( Robinson et al., 2021 ) that prevent trivializing the objective are difficult to find. As a result, contrastive learning objectives often exhibit feature suppression ( Chen et al., 2021a ) , where contrastive representations only capture a subset of relevant variables in a scene, for example probing well to object class but losing scene structure. To combat issues of hard negatives and feature suppression, substantial effort has been devoted to designing hand-crafted augmentations intended to highlight signal for desired variables ( Chen et al., 2020 ) . Representation learning has also seen success through predictive objectives, such as predicting masked-out pixels in an image as done in Context Encoders and MAE ( Pathak et al., 2016 ; He et al., 2022 ) , or by replacing the pixel prediction target with
a neural network latent such as BYOL, Data2Vec, JEPA, and MAGE ( Grill et al., 2020 ; Baevski et al., 2022 ; Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
代表性学习。 对比学习者(Chen等人,2020年;He等人,2020年)是代表学习的主线,通过鼓励同一场景的增强观点与不同场景的低相似性之间的高度相似性来监督损失目标. 在对比性目标方面取得实证改进后,广泛使用的DINO v1,v2,v3系列模型取得了巨大成功(Caron等人,2021年;Oquab等人,2024年;Siméoni等人,2025年)。 对比目标的一个长期缺陷是它们与有强烈条件的观点纠缠在一起,很难找到防止将目标淡化的硬性负面例子(Robinson等人,2021年)。 因此,对比性学习目标往往表现出特征抑制(Chen et al., 2021a),其中对比性表现只在某一场景中捕捉到一个相关变量的子集,例如对对象类的探测良好但失去场景结构. 为了解决硬性负作用和特征抑制问题,已作出大量努力,设计手动增强装置,以突出对预期变量的信号(Chen等人,2020年)。 代表性学习通过预测目标也取得了成功,如在上下文编码器和MAE(Pathak等人,2016年;He等人,2022年)中所做的图像中预测蒙蔽的像素,或者用像素预测目标取代像素预测目标。
神经网络潜伏,如BYOL、Data2Vec、JEPA和MAGE(Grill等人,2020年;Baevski等人,2022年;Assran等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年;Li等人,2022年)。

blocks.en:
Pointwise Mutual Information and Representations The Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) of the data is closely tied to many representation learning algorithms.
The connection between factorizing the PMI and representation learning was first established by Levy and Goldberg (2014) for Word2Vec ( Mikolov et al., 2013 ) and afterward extended to contrastive learning ( van den Oord et al., 2018a ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . The Platonic Representation Hypothesis ( Huh et al., 2024 ) proposes that large-scale neural networks emergently converge to similarly structured representations and suggests PMI factorization as a candidate for such a space. However, recent work ( Koepke et al., 2026 ) has shown that at large scales, neural representations fail to match such structure. In this work, we directly supervise representations to match the PMI, rather than assuming emergence at scale.
blocks.zh:
相互信息和说明 数据的Pointwise相互信息(PMI)与许多表达式学习算法密切相关.
Levy和Goldberg(2014年)首先为Word2Vec(Mikolov等人,2013年)建立了将PMI和代表学习纳入要素之间的联系,之后扩展至对比性学习(van den Oord等人,2018年a); 陈等,2023). Platonic Presentation Hypothesis(Huh等人,2024年)提出,大型神经网络会突然与结构相似的表达方式汇合,并建议PMI因子化作为这种空间的候选. 然而,最近的工作(Koepke等人,2026年)表明,在大尺度上,神经表达无法与这种结构相匹配. 在这项工作中,我们直接监督陈述,以便与防扩散机制相匹配,而不是假设规模的出现。

blocks.en:
Pixel and Latent Space Generative Modeling. The current state-of-the-art for image generative modeling uses diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , of which there are two main varieties: direct pixel diffusion and latent diffusion. A representative approach for pixel-space diffusion is JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) , which demonstrated that pixel-space diffusion can be a practical and scalable method using transformer architectures. Meanwhile, latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024a ) instead modifies generation into two stages, first creating a latent tokenizer, and second training a generative model on the tokenizer. Modern latent diffusion approaches like RAE ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) demonstrated strong results, attaining state-of-the-art FID values on ImageNet. However, RAE and REPA do not control for representation learner pretraining, where the chosen latent space, DINOv2-b ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) is distilled from a 1.1 billion parameter model trained on over 100 times more data than ImageNet.
As a result, the FLOP-efficiency of representation encoding is not currently understood.
blocks.zh:
像素和Latent空间基因模型化. 目前用于图像基因模型的先进技术使用扩散变压器(Peebles and Xie, 2023),其中主要有两种品种:直接像素扩散和潜在扩散. 像素空间扩散的一种代表性方法是JiT(Li and He, 2026),它证明了像素空间扩散可以是一种使用变压器架构的实用和可伸缩的方法. 与此同时,潜在扩散(Rombach等人,2022年;Li等人,2024年a)将一代修改为两个阶段,首先创建潜在的显像剂,其次在显像剂上培训基因模型。 现代潜在扩散方法,如RAE(郑等人,2026年)和REPA(Yu等人,2025年),都显示出强有力的成果,在ImageNet上取得了最新的FID值。 然而,RAE和REPA并不控制代表学习者预训,选择的潜在空间DINOv2-b(Oquab等人,2024年)是从11亿个参数模型中提炼出来的,其数据比ImageNet多100倍。
因此,目前不理解代表编码的FLOP效率.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
We now give a high-level overview of our algorithm.
Given a training sample, we randomly mask to obtain two corrupted views, 𝐱 {\mathbf{x}} and 𝐲 {\mathbf{y}} . We then obtain an estimate of their PMI using a conditional generative model following Eq. 3 . In parallel, just as in contrastive learning, we embed each view into a feature using a representation encoder R θ R_{\theta} . blocks.en: In this section, we will briefly review how to extract probabilities from generative models. We assume that all data is discrete: images have 24-bit pixels and model latents are represented by finite-precision floating points. Conditional likelihood, and therefore PMI, is simple to estimate from discrete cross-entropy models for both text ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) and images ( Li et al., 2025 ) which output log-probabilities for individual tokens given a context.

blocks.en:
Practical implementations of diffusion models do not directly optimize the ELBO but rather a timestep-weighted version ( Karras et al., 2022 ) . While likelihood weights every bit of information equally, information at lower signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) often carries greater semantic or perceptual importance, and therefore, diffusion models benefit by biasing a finite-capacity model towards the most important SNRs. Likewise, the standard PMI treats all shared information equally, including fine-grained information that is only predictable at very high SNRs.
For representation learning, we instead introduce an inductive bias for which SNRs determine similarity. blocks.en: Likelihood estimation gets harder as the amount of information in the input grows: predicting the probability of a single pixel is easy and calculable with dataset statistics, but predicting the likelihood of an image using a diffusion model may take intractably many Monte Carlo Estimation steps. To avoid this issue, we replace a challenging full-view PMI estimate with a sequence of local PMI increments. Instead of estimating the PMI between 𝐱 {\mathbf{x}} and an entire large target 𝐲 {\mathbf{y}} , we write 𝐲 {\mathbf{y}} as tokens y 1 , … , y k y_{1},...,y_{k} and supervise only the incremental PMI contributed by the next token: ⟨ R θ ​ ( 𝐱 ) , R θ ​ ( y ≤ k ) − R θ ​ ( y ≤ k − 1 ) ⟩ = PMI ⁡ ( 𝐱 , y ≤ k ) − PMI ⁡ ( 𝐱 , y ≤ k − 1 ) \displaystyle\left\langle R_{\theta}({\mathbf{x}}),R_{\theta}(y{\leq k})-R_{\theta}(y_{\leq k-1})\right\rangle=\operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},y_{\leq k})-\operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},y_{\leq k-1}) = ∑ i = 1 k log ⁡ p ⁡ ( y i ∣ y < i , 𝐱 ) p ⁡ ( y i ∣ y < i ) − ∑ i = 1 k − 1 log ⁡ p ⁡ ( y i ∣ y < i , 𝐱 ) p ⁡ ( y i ∣ y < i ) = log ⁡ p ⁡ ( y k ∣ y < k , 𝐱 ) p ⁡ ( y k ∣ y < k ) = PMI ⁡ ( y k , 𝐱 ∣ y < k ) . \displaystyle\qquad=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\log\frac{p(y_{i}\mid y_{<i},{\mathbf{x}})}{p(y_{i}\mid y_{<i})}-\sum_{i=1}^{k-1}\log\frac{p(y_{i}\mid y_{<i},{\mathbf{x}})}{p(y_{i}\mid y_{<i})}=\log\frac{p(y_{k}\mid y_{<k},{\mathbf{x}})}{p(y_{k}\mid y_{<k})}=\operatorname{PMI}(y_{k},{\mathbf{x}}\mid y_{<k}). blocks.en: Here, we describe how we instantiate RePR for learning representations from images. RePR consists of two learned networks: a “Prediction Model” that predicts masked inputs given partial observations (to estimate the PMI), and a “Representation Model” that outputs vectors given a partial input (into which we distill the PMI). In the following sections, we describe the Prediction Model (Sec. 5.1 ), the Representation Model for patch features (Sec. 5.2 ), how we mask views for PMI calculation (Sec. 5.3 ), and estimating the PMI with respect to latents for improved performance (Sec. 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们描述我们如何从图像中学习表现的即时反应。 RePR由两个学习到的网络组成:一个是“预测模型”,预测部分观察(估计PMI)得到的遮蔽输入;另一个是“代表模型”,输出部分输入的矢量(我们在其中提炼PMI)。 在以下各节中,我们描述了预测模型(Sec.5.1)、补丁特性的代表模型(Sec.5.2)、我们如何掩盖对PMI计算的看法(Sec.5.3),以及对改进性能的潜伏因素的估计(Sec.5.4)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Prediction Model
blocks.zh: 5.1 预测模型

blocks.en: The “Prediction Model” is implemented as a MAR ( Li et al., 2024b ) , a modification of Masked Autoencoders ( He et al., 2022 ) that replaces the patch regression head with a patch diffusion MLP. Specifically, MAR consists of an MAE Encoder E θ E_{\theta} (without mask tokens), MAE Decoder D θ D_{\theta} (with mask tokens) and a diffusion MLP M θ M_{\theta} . The diffusion MLP takes in the decoder latent corresponding to patch p , z p p,z_{p} , a noised view of p p , p t p_{t} , and trains to denoise p p , where we follow JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) and use x x -prediction with a v-loss, depicted in Figure 1 . blocks.en: 5.2 Representing Patch Features
blocks.zh: 5.2 代表补丁特征

blocks.en: We distinguish between features that are directly supervised for structure, such as the CLS token of Contrastive Learners, DINO, or LeJEPA, and unregularized intermediate latents, such as the non-CLS tokens of DINO or the latents in an unregularized autoencoder. Without explicit structural supervision, these unregularized latents can diverge or collapse. For example, DINOv2 demonstrated outlier patch features, motivating the introduction of register tokens ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) , and in DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , feature quality again degraded, necessitating an additional distillation stage to align model features with an earlier checkpoint, taken before degradation occurred. While heuristic regularization and interventions can correct divergence, these issues may become increasingly difficult to control with greater scale. Such feature instability motivates directly supervising patch features for principled and scalable tokenization.
blocks.zh: 我们区分了直接为结构所监督的特性,例如CLS spord of Contrastics Learners, DINO, 或 LeJEPA, 和未规范的中间潜质, 如DINO的非CLS spords 或未规范的自动编码器中的潜质. 如果没有明确的结构监督,这些未规范化的潜伏物可能出现分歧或崩溃。 例如,DINOv2显示了外部补丁特征,促使引入登记符(Darcet等人,2024年),在DINOv3(Siméoni等人,2025年)中,质量再次下降,需要增加一个蒸馏阶段,使模型特征与退化发生之前的检查站保持一致。 虽然僵持的正规化和干预可以纠正分歧,但随着规模的扩大,这些问题可能越来越难以控制。 这种特征的不稳定性促使人们直接监督补丁特征,以便有原则和可扩展的标志化。

blocks.en: We directly use the full patch features R H × W × D R^{H\times W\times D} from our network as our representation vector. To enforce spatial structure, we implement an additional spatial equivariance constraint: We remove absolute position information from the Encoder E θ E_{\theta} , however we take the dot product of patch features at their absolute positions. To implement this, our Representation Model cross-attends from output of the encoder E E , to learned position embeddings indexed by their relative offset to the center of the visible input, visualized in Fig. 1 , right.

blocks.zh: 5.3 化妆战略

For a given input image X X , during masking we produce two potentially overlapping patch masks A A and B B , as well as a non-overlapping target patch p p that is denoised by the MAR head. Following MAR, we use a randomized masking strategy
where the masking ratio is randomly sampled from U ⁡ [ M A , 100 % ] U[M_{A},100\%] and U ⁡ [ M B , 100 % ] U[M_{B},100\%] respectively. By randomly choosing the masking ratio instead of fixing a single masking ratio, we supervise a range of context sizes to reconstruct the telescoping series in Sec. 4.3 . For additional efficiency, we observe that we can reuse the calculation for E ⁡ ( B ​ p ) E(Bp) for several different views A i A_{i} , and we can reuse the decoder pass to predict several target patches p j p_{j} for only additional integration cost. In our final implementation we therefore add hyperparameters A Repeat A_{\text{Repeat}} and p Repeat p_{\text{Repeat}} for efficiency. Algorithm code in Appendix 1

blocks.en: 5.4 Iterative Feature Prediction
blocks.zh: 5.4 迭代特征预测

blocks.en:
We find that recursively applying our training technique, by replacing the predicted incremental patches with features from a previous cycle of training, can yield additional gains. This mirrors findings in representation learning, where self-supervision by predicting in a feature space ( Hsu et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Baevski et al., 2022 ) has been shown to strongly improve representation quality over direct pixel prediction objectives such as MAE ( He et al., 2022 ) .
Because a factorization of the PMI can reconstruct the input at optimality (App. A.4 ), unweighted PMI estimation for latent prediction is the same as for pixel prediction: PMI ⁡ ( 𝐱 , R θ ​ ( 𝐲 ) ) = PMI ⁡ ( 𝐱 , 𝐲 ) \operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},R_{\theta}({\mathbf{y}}))=\operatorname{PMI}({\mathbf{x}},{\mathbf{y}}) . With timestep weighting and bootstrapped prediction, feature-space prediction provides further control over learning signal.
In practice, we embed the entire image R θ old ​ ( 𝐱 ) R_{\theta_{\text{old}}}({\mathbf{x}}) and substitute incremental patch p p for the patch representation corresponding to the same location in the image. By sharing feature calculation between A Repeat A_{\text{Repeat}} views, embedding with R θ old R_{\theta_{\text{old}}} is implementationally cheap.

blocks.en: 5.5 Joint Optimization
blocks.zh: 5.5 联合优化

blocks.en: Our approach trains the Prediction Model and the Representation Model jointly, simultaneously optimizing the losses in Eq. 16 and 15 . Empirically, we find the Representation Model converges relatively easily, therefore to speed training, we lazily optimize, training the Representation Model R θ R_{\theta} only once every four training iterations.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: We empirically evaluate our approach for the task of image generation on ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) and the text-to-image dataset GPIC ( Chandrasegaran et al., 2026 ) . In this section, we demonstrate that RePR is robust to Feature Suppression (Sec. 6.1 ), provide scaling laws for RePR as a Tokenizer Encoder (Sec. 6.2 ), and use RePR to obtain compute-optimal pixel diffusion (Sec. 6.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们实证地评价我们在ImageNet(Deng等人,2009年)和GPIC(Chandrasegaran等人,2026年)上图像生成任务的方法。 在本节中,我们表明RePR对Feature Puture(Sec 6.1)是坚固的,为RePR提供了作为Tokenizer编码器的缩放定律(Sec 6.2),并使用RePR来获得计算-最佳像素扩散(Sec 6.3).

blocks.en: 6.1 Feature Suppression
blocks.zh: 6.1 特征抑制

blocks.en: Figure 2: Discriminative representation learning can suffer from feature suppression when a small subset of features, such as a watermark, is sufficient to distinguish examples. This degrades representation quality, as reflected by collapsing ImageNet class-probing performance. RePR remains robust to feature suppression.
blocks.zh: 图 2:当一个小的子集特征,如水印,足以区分实例时,歧视性的表示性学习可能会受到特征抑制的影响. 这降低了表现质量,这体现在ImageNet类测试性能崩溃。 REPR仍然很强壮,可以进行抑制。

blocks.en: Existing representation learning methods such as contrastive learning suffer from an issue called Feature Suppression ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021a ; Li et al., 2023 ) where a self-supervised objective might learn only a minimal subset of features necessary to solve the downstream task (e.g. instance discrimination), while dropping the remaining latent variables. This can be disastrous when training tokenizers because the additional latent variables, while perhaps unnecessary for satisfying the contrastive objective, may be essential for reconstructing the data.
blocks.zh: 现有的代表性学习方法,如对比性学习,会遇到一个叫做Feature Pression的问题(Geirhos等人,2020年;Chen等人,2021年a;Li等人,2023年),一个自我监督的目标可能只学习解决下游任务(例如歧视)所必需的最低限度的子集特征,同时降低剩余的潜在变量. 在培训标语器时,这可能是灾难性的,因为额外的潜在变量虽然可能对于满足对比性目标来说是不必要的,但对于数据重建可能是必不可少的。

blocks.en: To show our method is robust to Feature Suppression, we benchmark on a version of Imagenet that adds a visual watermark to every image patch that uniquely identifies the image in the dataset ( Enigma, 2026 ) . On such a dataset, contrastive losses become trivialized: merely identifying the image patch watermark is enough to attain a perfect loss. In Fig. 2 , we train LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) , DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , and our proposed RePR approach on both standard ImageNet and on the watermarked version. On watermarked data, LeJEPA and DINOv3 collapse to only representing the shared watermark. Meanwhile, despite sharing the same PMI factorization guarantees as contrastive learners, our proposed RePR is robust.
blocks.zh: 为了显示我们的方法对Feature Puture来说是强健的,我们以一个版本的Imagenet为基准,该版本在数据集中唯一识别图像的每个图像补丁(Enigma, 2026)中添加一个视觉水印. 在这样的数据集上,对比性损失变得微不足道:仅仅识别图像补丁水印就足以实现完美的损失. 在图2中,我们培训了LeJEPA(Balestriero and LeCun, 2025年),DINOv3(Siméoni等人, 2025年), 以及我们提议的关于标准图像网和水印版的RePR方法。 在水印数据上,LeJEPA和DINOv3崩溃只代表共享水印. 同时,尽管与比较性学习者分享同样的PMI要素化保障,我们提出的RePR是稳健的.

blocks.en: 6.2 Scaling Laws
blocks.zh: 6.2 扩大法律

blocks.en: Figure 3: Tokenizer Encoder Scaling Laws: RePR predictably scales as a tokenizer encoder. blocks.en: In the previous section, we demonstrated that our method resists feature suppression on toy data, where prior representations collapse. In this section, we demonstrate encoder scaling laws: our model captures enough data for generation and predictably improves with scale on real data.
blocks.zh: 在前一节中,我们表明,我们的方法能够抵制对玩具数据的压制,因为先前的表示会崩溃。 在本节中,我们演示编码器缩放定律:我们的模型捕捉到足够生成的数据,并随着真实数据上的尺度而有可预期的改进.

blocks.en: We demonstrate encoder scaling laws using Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) , which first denoises in latent space and then generates pixels conditioned on the denoised latent. This lets us leverage the improved diffusability of learned representations while retaining generation directly in pixel space. The resulting generative process is lossless, avoiding the reconstruction–generation tradeoff of lossy latent tokenizers ( Yao et al., 2025b ) and isolating gains from diffusability rather than compression. Latent Forcing additionally enables controlled FLOP- and parameter-matched comparisons with direct pixel diffusion models such as JiT.
blocks.zh: 我们用Latent Forcing(Baade等人,2026年)演示编码器缩放定律,这些定律首先在潜伏空间中隐蔽,然后生成以隐形潜伏为条件的像素。 这使得我们可以利用所学表现方法的改进易变性,同时将一代直接保留在像素空间. 由此产生的遗传过程是无损失的,避免了重建 -- -- 以损失的潜在标致剂为交换条件(姚等人,2025年b),而是从易散性而不是压缩中分离收益。 Latent Forcing额外使受控的FLOP-和参数匹配的比对与JiT等直接像素扩散模型.

blocks.en: We train RePR encoders from scratch across a range of compute scales. Following μ \mu P ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , we perform width-only scaling, sweeping widths from 256 to 1024 while holding depth fixed. At maximum width, the inference architecture matches a standard ViT-L. Full architectural and training details are provided in Appendix A.3 .

blocks.en: 6.3 Compute Optimal Generation
blocks.zh: 6.3 计算最佳生成

blocks.en: Figure 4: Total (Encoder + Diffusion) training compute versus FID-10K for JiT and JiT with Latent Forcing using RePR, showing that representation learning is compute-optimal for generation.

blocks.en:
To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first demonstration that representation learning combined with generative modeling can be more FLOP-efficient than direct generative modeling, even after accounting for the compute required to train both the representation and generative model.
We isolate the comparison by using Latent Forcing ( Baade et al., 2026 ) , without perceptual losses ( Johnson et al., 2016 ) , GANs ( Goodfellow et al., 2021 ) , or external decoders.
In Fig. 4 , we compare FID-10K on ImageNet between JiT-Large and Latent Forcing with two RePR tokenizer sizes for conditional and unconditional generation at equal FLOPs. At a compute budget of 1.19 × 10 20 1.19\times 10^{20} FLOPs, equal to 200 epochs of JiT-L training, RePR with JiT-L improves unguided FID-10K by 2.61 for conditional generation and 4.18 for unconditional generation versus JiT-L on pixels. In Tab. 4 , we demonstrate that our approach outperforms raw pixel diffusion with guidance, attaining an FID-50k of 2.18. Together with the encoder scaling laws established above, these results identify representation learning as an additional scaling axis that can improve generative performance more efficiently than scaling the generative model alone.

我们通过使用Latent Forcing(Baade等人,2026年)来隔离比较,没有知觉损失(Johnson等人,2016年),GANs(Goodfellow等人,2021年),或外部解码器.
以法义. 4,我们比较在ImageNet上的FID-10K在JiT-Large和Latent Forcing之间,比较两个RPR的代号大小,用于在等价FLOP条件下有条件和无条件的生成. 在1.19×10 20 1.19\times 10^{20}FLOPs的计算预算中,相当于200个时代的JiT-L训练,配有JiT-L的RePR将无制导的FID-10K改进为2.61有条件的生成,4.18无条件生成对像素上的JiT-L. 在Tab. 4中,我们表明,我们的方法在引导下超过了原始像素的传播,达到了FID-50k 2.18。 这些结果与上面确定的编码器缩放定律一起,将表示式学习确定为一个额外的缩放轴,可以比仅缩放基因模型更有效地提高基因性能.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce RePR, a theoretically motivated representation learning method for generative model tokenizers. RePR shares the theoretical guarantees of contrastive learning without requiring negative samples, while remaining robust to feature suppression in settings where prior representation learning methods collapse. We establish empirical scaling laws for diffusability and show that RePR-based generative models outperform direct diffusion on raw data at matched training FLOPs. Together, these results show that representation learning with strong theoretical foundations can coexist with and improve the scaling of generative modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了RePR,一种理论上有动机的表达学习方法,用于基因模型的标注剂. RePR与人分享了对比性学习的理论保障,而不需要负面样本,同时在先前代表性学习方法崩溃的环境下保持强力,以表现抑制。 我们制定了关于易散性的经验性衡量定律,并表明基于再PR的基因模型在相应的FLOP培训中比原始数据的直接传播要好。 这些结果共同表明,具有强大理论基础的代表性学习可以与基因模型并存并改进其规模。

blocks.en: To implement E θ E_{\theta} without providing absolute position information, we use RoPE position embeddings. For encoder register tokens, we assign RoPE position to the center of the unmasked tokens. When using center-relative offset queries (Sec. 5.2 ), R θ R_{\theta} can output representations for unobserved patches, including patches outside of the image. Like convolutional networks, which are also spatially-equivariant, we find it empirically useful to pad one row and column of representation queries outside of the image. We find that R θ R_{\theta} emergently expresses low, but nonzero magnitude on these padding tokens.
